findings.title: Evidence retains caller-controlled body and header fields
findings.requirement: Narrow task error/report privacy; source says request/response bodies and headers may contain secrets or reasoning and retain only safe failure class.
findings.observed: An object-valued model body field and session_id header both enter Server.record verbatim. Independent synthetic UnixHTTP accepted the request and retained 2 of 2 runtime privacy canaries in the resulting evidence.
findings.impact: A caller can persist sensitive or attacker-selected body/header content into the host evidence file. Arbitrary model objects expand the retained content beyond a model identifier. No real credential was used or exposed in this review.
findings.suggestion: Root/sole author should remove or hash caller header fields and restrict model recording to a validated harmless identifier or fixed approved model. Do not store arbitrary objects.
findings.adjudication: Root remains sole correction/adjudication owner; source untouched.

findings.title: Stream wall deadline is checked only before blocking reads
findings.requirement: Narrow task stream limits; source declares STREAM_SECONDS=180 and a response wall deadline.
findings.proof: evidence/deadline-results.json; deadline_check.py reduced-threshold delayed EOF assertion
findings.impact: A late EOF is recorded complete after the deadline. Production overshoot of the declared 180 seconds is inferred from the unchanged 30-second upstream socket timeout; it was not measured with a real upstream or 180-second wait.
findings.suggestion: Root/sole author can recheck after reads and constrain each upstream read to the remaining wall budget, or document the intended softer limit. Happy-path blocking priority belongs to the owner.

verified_synthetic_behaviors: HTTPS constructor uses chatgpt.com, POST /backend-api/codex/responses, and a default SSL context with certificate verification and hostname checks.
All six routing negatives stay out of transport; GET is rejected.
Caller Authorization, account identity, Host, Cookie, proxy credentials, forwarded target and Location are stripped. Only three attribution headers are admitted.
Synthetic redirect statuses 301/302/303/307/308 yield local 502, no forwarded Location, one transport call.
Owned private fixture directory is 0700; actual Unix socket is 0600. HTTP/1.0 close framing and a valid fixture SSE event are received intact.
Oversized normalized headers, excessive/negative lengths, duplicate lengths, transfer encoding and truncated body are rejected. Exact 2MiB request boundary is accepted.
stream must be true and store false. Six upstream slots reject excess admission with 429.
Non-200 upstream bodies, normal input and Authorization canaries, and transport exception messages are absent from response/error evidence.
Actual 16MiB response cap cuts the synthetic oversized stream, closes response and releases slot. Reduced 0.02s repeated-read stream cap reports failure.
Synthetic auth fixture is read without rewrite; expired synthetic auth is rejected without refresh and symlink auth is rejected.
